ei.title: Tips and Tricks for a Healthier Digital Life

fullPassage:
Tips and Tricks for a Healthier Digital Life

Managing our digital lives can be challenging. Do you sometimes worry that your online content might face copyright issues? Have you ever felt that you were being overly influenced by online shopping recommendations? Are you constantly checking for likes and comments on your social media posts? If you answered yes to any of these questions, here are some tips and ideas to help you have a healthier digital life.

Avoid Copyright Violations
Cathy is an enthusiastic gamer who shares her gameplays on a popular video-sharing platform. Recently, her channel was <u>suspended</u> for copyright violation issues. She was shocked to learn that the background music played within the game had a copyright <u>claim</u>. Now Cathy wants to know how to avoid similar issues in the future.

Cathy's mistake is not uncommon in the content creation community. Creators often miss embedded copyrighted material, such as background music, sound effects, images, and video clips. Even a brief appearance of such material can put creators at risk of a copyright <u>claim</u>.

To avoid any potential copyright issues, creators should research their creation to check if any of its components are copyrighted. If they come across copyrighted content, they should contact the copyright owner for permission to use it, replace it with non-copyrighted material, or remove it completely. Utilizing material with a Creative Commons (CC) license might also be a good idea. Most of this material can be used at no cost as long as certain rules are followed. These simple steps can help content creators avoid unexpected copyright issues and have some peace of mind about their work.

Break Free from Filter Bubbles
Meet Alex, a high school student with a passion for fashion. He often finds inspiration on social media and enjoys shopping online. Recently, however, he has realized that he keeps buying the same style of clothes. Even when he wants to try out new styles, he has a difficult time getting fresh ideas or recommendations on his preferred online platforms.

Alex is trapped in a filter bubble! Online shops and social media platforms use algorithms to "filter" out content for you based on your past purchases, likes, and search history. As a result, you might find yourself stuck inside a "bubble" of <u>limited</u> information that only <u>reinforces</u> your existing beliefs and preferences. If Alex had been aware of this, he wouldn't have missed out on new and diverse styles outside his bubble.

To stay away from filter bubbles, it is important to regularly check whether you are already trapped inside one. One way to do this is by performing searches on your favorite online platforms after logging out. Compare the search results and recommendations with what you usually see when you are logged in. If there is a big difference between them, you may have been trapped in a filter bubble.

Managing your personal information is another key to avoiding filter bubbles. Whenever you go online, your activities are saved as cookies on your computer. Websites can collect them based on your consent. You can remove or limit your consent on the websites or delete the cookies on your computer on a regular basis. This way, you can reduce the amount of personal data that you unconsciously share as you visit websites. Take action to break free from your filter bubble and open yourself up to new ideas.

Be Happy on Social Media
Social media is a big part of Min's life. She posts photos every day and enjoys getting likes and comments. Lately, however, she began to be concerned about her social media activity. She realizes that she spends a considerable amount of time repeatedly checking her feed, desperately seeking more likes. She even feels disappointed when she sees her friends' posts receiving more likes than hers.

Social media is a powerful tool that helps us connect with others, but it also has its downsides. One of them is that many people place <u>excessive</u> value on the number of likes and comments they get on their posts. Those who feel that they don't get enough likes, like Min, may experience feelings of shame or rejection. This can lead to severe anxiety. In addition, comparing their posts with more popular ones can make them feel inferior and harm their self-esteem. It can even cause depression.

To make social media a positive part of your daily life, it is important to use it <u>mindfully</u> with some guidelines. First, don't let social media consume all your time and attention. A quick and easy way to do this is to set limits on your usage or take regular breaks from social media. This will free up your time and energy to engage in activities outside the online world. Second, keep in mind that social media is a tool to network with others, not a platform for competition. When you start to feel unpopular or inferior, remember that what you see online presents only the highlights of other people's lives and does not reflect their entire story. If you still feel envious, use that emotion as motivation that helps you with your personal growth. By following these rules, you can make the most of social media and feel more at ease in your digital interactions.

questions.passage: Cathy is an (A)[enthusiastic / reluctant] gamer who shares her gameplays on a popular video-sharing platform. Recently, her channel was (B)[suspended / promoted] for copyright violation issues. She was (C)[shocked / relieved] to learn that the background music played within the game had a copyright claim. Now Cathy wants to know how to avoid similar issues in the future.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: Cathy는 열성적인(enthusiastic) 게이머이며, 채널이 저작권 위반으로 정지되었고(suspended), 배경음악에 저작권 청구가 있다는 사실에 충격받았다(shocked).
det.analysis:
✅ ① enthusiastic — suspended — shocked
❌ ② reluctant — suspended — relieved
❌ ③ enthusiastic — promoted — shocked
❌ ④ reluctant — promoted — relieved
✅ (A) enthusiastic: 열성적인 게이머. reluctant(꺼리는)는 맥락 불일치.
✅ (B) suspended: 저작권 위반으로 채널 정지. promoted(승진/홍보)는 반대.
✅ (C) shocked: 저작권 청구 사실에 충격. relieved(안도한)는 부적절.
det.tip: enthusiastic(열정적인) ↔ reluctant(꺼리는), suspended(정지된) ↔ promoted(홍보된)

questions.passage: She was shocked to learn that the background music played within the game had a copyright claim. Now Cathy wants to know how to avoid similar issues in the future. Cathy's mistake is not (A)[uncommon / unusual] in the content creation community. Creators often miss (B)[embedded / deleted] copyrighted material, such as background music, sound effects, images, and video clips. Even a (C)[brief / prolonged] appearance of such material can put creators at risk of a copyright claim. To avoid any potential copyright issues, creators should research their creation to check if any of its components are copyrighted.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: Cathy의 실수는 콘텐츠 창작 커뮤니티에서 흔치 않은 것이 아니다(uncommon). 크리에이터들은 삽입된(embedded) 저작물을 놓친다. 그런 자료의 짧은(brief) 등장도 위험을 초래한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① uncommon — embedded — brief
❌ ② unusual — embedded — prolonged
❌ ③ uncommon — deleted — brief
❌ ④ unusual — deleted — prolonged
✅ (A) uncommon: 'not uncommon' = 꽤 흔하다. unusual도 비슷하지만 원문은 uncommon.
✅ (B) embedded: 게임 안에 삽입된 저작물. deleted(삭제된)는 반대 의미.
✅ (C) brief: 짧은 등장도 위험. prolonged(길게 지속된)는 문맥상 부적절.
det.tip: embedded(내장된/삽입된): 게임 내 배경음악처럼 포함된 콘텐츠. not uncommon = 이중부정으로 '꽤 흔하다'는 뜻.

questions.passage: Even when he wants to try out new styles, he has a difficult time getting fresh ideas or recommendations on his preferred online platforms. Alex is trapped in a filter bubble! Online shops and social media platforms use (A)[algorithms / manuals] to "filter" out content for you based on your past purchases, likes, and search history. As a result, you might find yourself stuck inside a "bubble" of limited information that only (B)[reinforces / undermines] your existing beliefs and preferences. If Alex had been (C)[aware / ignorant] of this, he wouldn't have missed out on new and diverse styles outside his bubble. To stay away from filter bubbles, it is important to regularly check whether you are already trapped inside one.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 온라인 상점은 알고리즘(algorithms)을 사용하여 콘텐츠를 필터링한다. 제한된 정보의 거품이 기존 신념을 강화한다(reinforces). Alex가 이를 알았더라면(aware) 놓치지 않았을 것이다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① algorithms — reinforces — aware
❌ ② manuals — reinforces — ignorant
❌ ③ algorithms — undermines — aware
❌ ④ algorithms — reinforces — ignorant
✅ (A) algorithms: 맞춤 콘텐츠 필터링 기술. manuals(설명서)는 기술 맥락 불일치.
✅ (B) reinforces: 기존 신념을 강화. undermines(약화시키다)는 반대.
✅ (C) aware: '알았더라면' 가정법. ignorant(무지한)는 문맥 반대.
det.tip: 가정법 과거완료: If Alex had been aware ~ he wouldn't have missed. 과거 사실의 반대 가정.

questions.passage: To avoid any potential copyright issues, creators should ①<u>research</u> their creation to check if any of its components are copyrighted. If they come across copyrighted content, they should contact the copyright owner for ②<u>permission</u> to use it, ③<u>replace</u> it with non-copyrighted material, or ④<u>preserve</u> it completely. Utilizing material with a Creative Commons (CC) license might also be a good idea.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ④ 원문은 'remove it completely(완전히 제거하다)'인데 preserve(보존하다)는 반대 의미.
det.analysis:
✅ ① research: 자신의 창작물을 조사. 원문 일치.
✅ ② permission: 허락을 구하다. 원문 일치.
✅ ③ replace: 비저작권 자료로 교체. 원문 일치.
❌ ④ preserve → remove: 저작물을 '보존'이 아니라 '완전히 제거'해야 함.
det.tip: remove(제거하다) ↔ preserve(보존하다): 저작권 침해 방지를 위해 제거해야 하므로 preserve는 부적절.

questions.passage: Social media is a ①<u>powerful</u> tool that helps us connect with others, but it also has its downsides. One of them is that many people place ②<u>excessive</u> value on the number of likes and comments they get on their posts. Those who feel that they don't get enough likes may experience feelings of shame or ③<u>acceptance</u>. This can lead to severe ④<u>anxiety</u>.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ③ 원문은 'rejection(거부감)'인데 acceptance(수용)는 반의어로 부적절.
det.analysis:
✅ ① powerful: 강력한 도구. 원문 일치.
✅ ② excessive: 과도한 가치. 원문 일치.
❌ ③ acceptance → rejection: 좋아요를 충분히 못 받으면 '수용'이 아니라 '거부감/거절감'을 느낌.
✅ ④ anxiety: 심한 불안으로 이어질 수 있음. 원문 일치.
det.tip: rejection(거절감) ↔ acceptance(수용): 좋아요 부족 → 수치심이나 거절감.

questions.passage: To make social media a positive part of your daily life, it is important to use it ①<u>mindfully</u> with some guidelines. First, don't let social media ②<u>consume</u> all your time and attention. Second, keep in mind that social media is a tool to network with others, not a platform for ③<u>cooperation</u>. When you start to feel unpopular or inferior, remember that what you see online presents only the ④<u>highlights</u> of other people's lives.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ③ 원문은 'competition(경쟁)'인데 cooperation(협력)은 반의어로 부적절.
det.analysis:
✅ ① mindfully: 신중하게 사용. 원문 일치.
✅ ② consume: 시간과 관심을 소모. 원문 일치.
❌ ③ cooperation → competition: 소셜미디어는 '협력'이 아니라 '경쟁'의 장이 되면 안 된다는 맥락.
✅ ④ highlights: 다른 사람 삶의 하이라이트만 보여줌. 원문 일치.
det.tip: competition(경쟁) ↔ cooperation(협력): 원문은 소셜미디어가 경쟁 플랫폼이 아니라는 맥락.

questions.passage: Managing our digital lives can be challenging. Do you sometimes worry that your online content might face copyright issues? Have you ever felt that you were being overly influenced by online shopping recommendations? Are you constantly checking for likes and comments on your social media posts? If you answered yes to any of these questions, here are some tips and ideas to help you have a __________ digital life.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 글 전체가 더 건강한(healthier) 디지털 생활을 위한 팁을 제공하는 내용이다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② healthier: 제목 'Healthier Digital Life'와 일치. 건강한 디지털 생활.
❌ ① complicated(복잡한): 목표가 아님.
❌ ③ dangerous(위험한): 반대 의미.
❌ ④ competitive(경쟁적인): 무관한 맥락.
det.tip: healthier(더 건강한): 비교급. 현재보다 더 나은 디지털 생활을 목표로 하는 글.

questions.passage: To stay away from filter bubbles, it is important to regularly check whether you are already trapped inside one. One way to do this is by performing searches on your favorite online platforms after logging out. Compare the search results and recommendations with what you usually see when you are logged in. If there is a big difference between them, you may have been trapped in a __________.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 로그아웃 후 검색 결과가 다르면 필터 버블(filter bubble)에 갇힌 것이다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ filter bubble: 문단 주제가 필터 버블 탈출 방법.
❌ ① comfort zone: 안전지대. 무관.
❌ ② social network: 소셜 네트워크. 맥락 불일치.
❌ ④ copyright issue: 저작권 문제. 다른 섹션 주제.
det.tip: filter bubble(필터 버블): 알고리즘이 사용자 취향에 맞는 정보만 보여줘서 다양성이 사라지는 현상.

questions.passage: Managing your personal information is another key to avoiding filter bubbles. Whenever you go online, your activities are saved as __________ on your computer. Websites can collect them based on your consent. You can remove or limit your consent on the websites or delete them on your computer on a regular basis. This way, you can reduce the amount of personal data that you unconsciously share as you visit websites.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 온라인 활동이 컴퓨터에 쿠키(cookies)로 저장된다.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ cookies: 웹사이트가 수집하는 데이터. 원문 일치.
❌ ① passwords(비밀번호): 활동 기록이 아님.
❌ ② bookmarks(북마크): 직접 저장하는 것.
❌ ③ algorithms(알고리즘): 저장되는 데이터가 아님.
det.tip: cookies(쿠키): 웹사이트 방문 시 컴퓨터에 저장되는 작은 데이터 파일. 맞춤 광고 등에 활용.

questions.passage: Cathy is an enthusiastic gamer who shares her gameplays on a popular video-sharing platform. Recently, her channel was <u>suspended</u> for copyright violation issues. She was shocked to learn that the background music played within the game had a copyright <u>claim</u>. Now Cathy wants to know how to avoid similar issues in the future.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 <u>suspended</u>와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: suspended(정지된)와 가장 가까운 의미는 halted(중단된)이다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② halted: 중단된/멈춘. suspended와 유사.
❌ ① promoted(홍보된): 반대.
❌ ③ expanded(확장된): 무관.
❌ ④ launched(출시된): 반대 방향.
det.tip: suspend(정지시키다) = halt(중단하다) = pause(일시중지하다). 채널 정지 맥락.

questions.passage: Alex is trapped in a filter bubble! Online shops and social media platforms use algorithms to "filter" out content for you based on your past purchases, likes, and search history. As a result, you might find yourself stuck inside a "bubble" of <u>limited</u> information that only <u>reinforces</u> your existing beliefs and preferences. If Alex had been aware of this, he wouldn't have missed out on new and diverse styles outside his bubble.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 <u>reinforces</u>와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: reinforces(강화하다)와 가장 가까운 의미는 strengthens(강하게 하다)이다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① strengthens: 강화하다. reinforces와 동의어.
❌ ② weakens(약화시키다): 반의어.
❌ ③ replaces(대체하다): 무관.
❌ ④ ignores(무시하다): 무관.
det.tip: reinforce(강화하다) = strengthen(강하게 하다). 기존 신념과 선호를 더 굳히는 맥락.

questions.passage: Social media is a powerful tool that helps us connect with others, but it also has its downsides. One of them is that many people place <u>excessive</u> value on the number of likes and comments they get on their posts. Those who feel that they don't get enough likes, like Min, may experience feelings of shame or rejection. This can lead to severe anxiety. In addition, comparing their posts with more popular ones can make them feel inferior and harm their self-esteem.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 <u>excessive</u>와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: excessive(과도한)와 가장 가까운 의미는 extreme(극도의)이다.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ extreme: 극도의/지나친. excessive와 유사.
❌ ① moderate(적당한): 반의어.
❌ ② sufficient(충분한): 다른 의미.
❌ ③ reasonable(합리적인): 반대 뉘앙스.
det.tip: excessive(과도한) = extreme(극도의) = too much. moderate(적당한)는 반의어.

questions.passage: Even when he wants to try out new styles, he has a difficult time getting fresh ideas or recommendations on his preferred online platforms. Alex is trapped in a filter bubble! Online shops and social media platforms use algorithms to "filter" out content for you based on your past purchases, likes, and search history. As a result, you might find yourself stuck inside a "bubble" of <u>limited</u> information that only <u>reinforces</u> your existing beliefs and preferences.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 limited와 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.korean: limited(제한된)의 반의어는 unlimited(무제한의)이다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ unlimited: 무제한의. limited의 정확한 반의어.
❌ ① restricted(제한된): 동의어.
❌ ② narrow(좁은): 유사한 의미.
❌ ④ confined(제한된/갇힌): 동의어.
det.tip: limited(제한된) ↔ unlimited(무제한의). restricted, narrow, confined는 모두 limited와 비슷한 뜻.

questions.passage: To make social media a positive part of your daily life, it is important to use it <u>mindfully</u> with some guidelines. First, don't let social media consume all your time and attention. A quick and easy way to do this is to set limits on your usage or take regular breaks from social media. This will free up your time and energy to engage in activities outside the online world. Second, keep in mind that social media is a tool to network with others, not a platform for competition.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 mindfully와 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.korean: mindfully(신중하게)의 반의어는 carelessly(부주의하게)이다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② carelessly: 부주의하게. mindfully의 반의어.
❌ ① carefully(주의 깊게): 동의어.
❌ ③ thoughtfully(사려 깊게): 동의어.
❌ ④ deliberately(의도적으로): 유사한 뉘앙스.
det.tip: mindfully(마음 챙기며/신중하게) ↔ carelessly(부주의하게). carefully, thoughtfully, deliberately는 모두 유사어.

questions.passage: Cathy's mistake is not uncommon in the content creation community. Creators often miss embedded copyrighted material, such as background music, sound effects, images, and video clips. Even a brief appearance of such material can put creators at risk of a copyright <u>claim</u>.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 <u>claim</u>이 이 글에서 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 여기서 claim은 저작권에 대한 권리 주장/청구를 의미한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ 권리 주장, 청구: 저작권 청구(copyright claim) 맥락.
❌ ① 주장, 요구: 일반적 주장. 여기서는 법적 권리 청구.
❌ ② 영토, 지역: 무관.
❌ ④ 자격, 자질: 무관.
det.tip: claim: ① 주장하다(assert) ② (보험금 등을) 청구하다 ③ (법적) 권리를 주장하다. 여기서는 저작권 청구.

questions.stem: 다음 영영풀이에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "permission or agreement to do something"

det.korean: "무언가를 하기 위한 허락이나 동의" = consent(동의).
det.analysis:
✅ ② consent: 동의/허락. 'permission or agreement' 정의에 정확히 부합.
❌ ① algorithm(알고리즘): 절차/방법.
❌ ③ component(구성요소): 부분/요소.
❌ ④ violation(위반): 규칙 위반.
det.tip: consent(동의): 웹사이트가 쿠키를 수집할 때 사용자의 consent(동의)를 기반으로 함.

questions.passage: If they come across copyrighted content, they should contact the copyright owner for permission to use it, replace it with non-copyrighted material, or remove it completely. [utilize] material with a Creative Commons (CC) license might also be a good idea.
questions.stem: 괄호 안의 단어를 문맥에 맞게 변형하시오. [utilize]

det.korean: 문장 주어 역할을 하므로 동명사 Utilizing이 맞다.
det.analysis: 원문: 'Utilizing material with a CC license might also be a good idea.' 동명사(Utilizing)가 주어 역할.
det.tip: 동명사 주어: V-ing + 명사 + 동사. Utilizing material ... might be a good idea.

questions.passage: Those who feel that they don't get enough likes, like Min, may experience feelings of shame or rejection. This can lead to [severe] anxiety. In addition, comparing their posts with more popular ones can make them feel inferior and harm their self-esteem.
questions.stem: 괄호 안의 단어를 문맥에 맞게 변형하시오. [severe]

det.korean: 형용사 severe가 명사 anxiety를 수식하므로 변형 없이 그대로 사용.
det.analysis: 원문: 'severe anxiety(심각한 불안)'. severe는 이미 형용사로 anxiety를 수식. 변형 불필요.
det.tip: severe(심각한): 형용사. severely(부사)로 바꾸면 명사 anxiety를 수식할 수 없음.

questions.passage: Second, keep in mind that social media is a tool to network with others, not a platform for competition. When you start to feel unpopular or inferior, remember that what you see online presents only the highlights of other people's lives and does not reflect their entire story. If you still feel envious, use that emotion as __________ that helps you with your personal growth. By following these rules, you can make the most of social media and feel more at ease in your digital interactions.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 질투심을 개인 성장을 돕는 동기(motivation)로 활용하라는 맥락.
det.analysis:
✅ ① motivation: 동기/동력. 질투를 성장의 원동력으로 사용.
❌ ② punishment(벌): 부정적 맥락.
❌ ③ obstacle(장애물): 반대 의미.
❌ ④ distraction(방해물): 부정적 맥락.
det.tip: motivation(동기): 원문에서 부정적 감정(질투)을 긍정적 에너지(성장 동기)로 전환하라는 조언.

questions.passage: In addition, comparing their posts with more popular ones can make them feel inferior and harm their self-esteem. It can even cause depression. To make social media a positive part of your daily life, it is important to use it <u>mindfully</u> with some guidelines. First, don't let social media __________ all your time and attention. A quick and easy way to do this is to set limits on your usage or take regular breaks from social media.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 소셜미디어가 시간과 관심을 모두 소모하게(consume) 두지 말라는 맥락.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ consume: 소비하다/소모하다. 시간과 주의력을 다 잡아먹지 말라.
❌ ① generate(생성하다): 맥락 불일치.
❌ ② distribute(분배하다): 맥락 불일치.
❌ ③ monitor(감시하다): 맥락 불일치.
det.tip: consume(소모하다): 'consume all your time and attention' = 시간과 관심을 전부 빼앗다. let + 목적어 + 동사원형.
